title: Check for updates
gitHint: Git install: updates to the latest commit on the tracked branch {branch}. The update stops if you have uncommitted changes or local-only commits.
noNotes: This release has no release notes.
noReleases: The repository has no releases yet.
commitIncluded: The latest commit is already in the latest release.
compareFailed: Couldn't check for local changes, so the update stopped. Try again, or cancel the update.
overwrites_one: The target version will overwrite or delete {count} file you changed locally:
overwrites_other: The target version will overwrite or delete {count} files you changed locally:
patchSaved: Your local changes were saved as a patch:
patchFailed: Couldn't save a patch, so these changes can't be restored automatically.
applyFastForward: This fast-forwards to {target}, rebuilds, and restarts the service. The bot will be offline briefly.
applyDownload: This downloads {target}, rebuilds, and restarts the service. The bot will be offline briefly.
failedHint: The service wasn't restarted. See the error above and the update log.
